backlog.title: D2: M2 Redesign — successor-chaining only + Tab contract hardening
backlog.description: Ship the D2 delta on top of the complete M1+M2 codebase: enforce the one-word completion invariant (delete the entire multi-word phrase layer, keep only the raw-text-adjacency bigram successor index), harden segmentation against non-ASCII-adjacent runs, make Tab only ever complete (forced single-item mitigation against pi-tui's Tab flow), redesign chaining to offer successors at zero typed chars with bare one-word values, rename the config gate to enableChaining with a deprecated enablePhrases alias, and sync changeset-level docs. Grounded in plan/002_3e8a42cadf2c/architecture/ (system_context.md + 5 recon reports). Out of scope per PRD: dictionary/admission/salience/thresholds, pi-tui modifications, persistence, telemetry.

tasks.title: Segmentation: disqualify ASCII runs adjacent to Unicode letters (R2)
tasks.description: A word candidate must be bounded on both sides by non-letter characters where any Unicode letter counts as a letter; never slice a non-ASCII letter out of a word and complete the ASCII remainder.

subtasks.title: Unicode-letter boundary rejection in segment.ts tokenize
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: plan/002_3e8a42cadf2c/architecture/ingest_segment_map.md §2 — BASE_RE /[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,63}/g (src/core/segment.ts ~line 47) simply restarts matching after a non-ASCII run, so today 'Þórhildur' yields 'rhildur' and 'ΩbsidianMirror' yields 'bsidianMirror'; internal SpanToken already carries start/end before the merge loop drops them.
2. INPUT: none — leaf pure module (src/core/segment.ts imports only src/core/types.ts).
3. LOGIC: Implement PRD §04 segmentation rule 3 (R2): after the base and hexish scans, reject any candidate whose immediately-preceding OR immediately-following source character is a Unicode letter (test with /\p{L}/u — ASCII letters cannot abut a same-class match, so this effectively means non-ASCII letters: CJK, Latin-1). Hook: tokenize Pass 1 base loop (~lines 65–75, m.index in hand) checks text[m.index-1] and text[m.index+m[0].length]; apply the analogous guard to hexish spans (digit-led runs are word candidates too). '漢字 word' still yields 'word' (space-bounded); '草sword' → nothing. Update test/segment.test.ts: replace the 'resumes ASCII tokens after a non-ASCII run' case with whole-run-disqualification cases (Þórhildur→nothing, ΩbsidianMirror→nothing, 草sword→nothing) while keeping pure-ASCII-after-CJK-run-punctuation cases. NOTE: prd_snapshot §09 (h2.49) still lists the old 'CJK run skipped; ASCII resumes after' bullet — the delta R2 explicitly overrides it.
4. OUTPUT: tokenize()/expandCandidates() signatures unchanged (strings-only out); strictly fewer RawTokens emitted. Consumed in-place by every ingest test and by P1.M1.T3.S1 (span threading, same file).
5. DOCS: none — internal module, no user-facing/config/API surface change; README sweep is P1.M4.T2.S1 (Mode B).

subtasks.title: Chain machine + provider armed branch redesign (bare values, threshold 0)
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: plan/002_3e8a42cadf2c/architecture/pi_layer_map.md §1 — armed branch at src/pi/provider.ts 239–316: the pending one-shot (chain.consumePending() + before.endsWith(armed.word)) returns leading-space values at line 254 (value: ` ${s.next}`) with liveKeyByValue.set(' '+next, …) at ~280; the fragment path (292–316) filters successors at de-facto threshold 1. external_deps.md §2a CONFIRMS: with prefix '' pi-tui splices item.value verbatim at the cursor, so a BARE word after the separating whitespace is correctly word-separated, while a leading-space value would double-space; the plain applyCompletion path adds NO trailing space (the user's separating space is the boundary — 'zero typed chars' means zero chars of the next word).
2. INPUT: store.topSuccessors (P1.M1.T2.S1), adjacency-fed successor index (P1.M1.T3.S2), single-word rankMatches (P1.M1.T2.S2).
3. LOGIC: Implement PRD §07 h2.43: retire pending/consumePending and leading-space values. armed(W): (a) cursor at an empty word start (text-before-cursor ends with [ \t], or line start) → return UNFILTERED topSuccessors(W) items with bare value s.next, label s.next, description 'chain', prefix '' — the successor IS the top result before anything is typed; (b) typed fragment F (≥1 word chars) → filter s.next by case-insensitive prefix, threshold 0 for the whole chain duration; (c) disqualification — non-Tab keys that leave a non-word-start/non-fragment context (escape, punctuation, no successors) → chain.reset() and fall through to the normal path; typing never blocks, it only filters. Tab-accept of a chain item transitions armed(next) via the CHAIN_KEY_PREFIX live-key mechanism (keep); applyCompletion: DELETE the phrase-key arm case; bare whole words still arm; trigger-char completions arm; arming only from hapax's own liveKeyByValue candidates, never path completion. createChainMachine simplifies to armed-only (pending dies; keep arm/reset/state). PRESERVE test/chain.test.ts case (8) semantics — word-less buffer disarm+delegate (pinned by a comment at provider.ts ~265; PRD R4 explicitly keeps it). If real-editor validation contradicts the bare-value separation, document the exact constraint in the task BEFORE choosing a minimal fix; multi-word values remain FORBIDDEN regardless.
4. OUTPUT: provider chain layer consumed by P1.M2.T2.S1 (forced truncation of armed results); reset wiring in index.ts before_agent_start is unchanged (verify it still resets the simplified machine).
5. DOCS: none — the usage example is rewritten changeset-level in P1.M4.T2.S1 (Mode B).

subtasks.title: provider.ts force branch (abort → armed → force-aware returns → normal)
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:

RESEARCH NOTE: plan/002_3e8a42cadf2c/architecture/external_deps.md §1e + pi_layer_map.md — VERIFIED: options.force is never read in provider.ts today; delegate paths already forward the ORIGINAL options object (identity preserved). pi-tui editor.js:1903: `options.force && options.explicitTab && suggestions.items.length === 1` → applyCompletion applied immediately; items.length > 1 → menu opens in 'force' state (the Tab-opens-menu bug). 2. INPUT: redesigned armed branch (P1.M2.T1.S1); single-word ranked results (P1.M1.T2.S2).
